key_insight: Soft-MoQE learns input-dependent mixtures of fixed quantum feature maps, achieving competitive performance without training quantum parameters.
engineering_relevance: Moving trainable components to a classical gating network reduces quantum training cost and avoids quantum-parameter optimization difficulties.
method: Build a heterogeneous pool of fixed quantum circuits that produce distinct feature embeddings.
Train a classical gating network to weight expert embeddings for each input.
Combine embeddings through soft, input-dependent routing.
evidence_signal: On PCA-reduced MNIST parity, MNIST 10-class, and FashionMNIST, Soft-MoQE outperformed the best single expert, uniform expert averaging, and a linear baseline, with task-dependent performance comparable to a trainable quantum neural network and orders-of-magnitude lower quantum training cost.
watch_item: Results are limited to PCA-reduced benchmarks; robustness to hardware noise and scaling to larger inputs remain unestablished by the abstract.
paper_title: Soft Mixture of Quantum Experts for Hybrid Quantum-Classical Learning
